title: Fresh Orange Sherbet with Whipped Cream
summary: A bright, refreshing orange sherbet lightened with whipped cream, creating a cloud-like frozen texture.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Pulse
steps.text: Pulse 1 tbsp finely grated orange zest, 200 g sugar and ⅛ tsp fine salt in a food processor until damp, 10-15 pulses.

steps.title: Juice
steps.text: With the motor running, pour in 480 ml fresh orange juice (about 6 oranges) and 3 tbsp lemon juice and process until the sugar dissolves, about 1 min.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Strain into a bowl, cover and chill in the freezer until very cold (about 4 °C), 30-60 min; do not let it freeze.

steps.title: Whip
steps.text: Whip 160 ml cold double cream in a second bowl to soft peaks.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Whisking constantly, pour the cold juice in a steady stream down the side of the bowl into the cream.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn at once until like soft-serve, 25-30 min.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Transfer to a container, press cling film on the surface and freeze until firm, at least 3 h.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Let stand a few minutes to soften before scooping; serve with orange segments.

tips: Do not let the juice mixture freeze solid before churning, or it will not combine smoothly with the cream
Keep the cream very cold until the moment you combine it with the juice for the best texture
Serve with fresh orange segments for a vibrant, citrusy finish
storage: Keep frozen; let stand a few minutes to soften before scooping.
